name: Vivian and Kyuma
source:
In a fantasy world, young goddess Vivian saves a drowning snake named Kyuma, who later reveals himself as the ninth son of the Dragon Lord. Feeling sorry for the little snake, Vivian aids Kyuma in regaining his powers and human form. How does that decision determine Vivian's fate?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2635910/]Steam[/url]]
